text:
carmen: Quick follow-up thread for the authz postmortem. Keeping this tight: we've got four remediation buckets to close (token parsing, perms drift, audit gaps, secret propagation). Need owners and concrete due epochs so I can mark them CLOSED in the tracker.

carmen: Short list: 
1) Token validation regression tests + patch -> owner @leo -> target 48h
2) Permissions "heatmap" + role-owner reconciliation -> owner @ana -> target 5d
3) Audit-guard alert + backfill helper -> owner @platform-sre -> target 72h
4) Secrets delta analyzer + reconcile job -> owner @platform-sre -> target 96h

leo: Ill take token tests and the proxy patch. Will add unit + integration cases reproducing the float-exp edge. Canary to staging, then roll.

carmen: Please add the test matrix to the doc and link it here.

leo: Will do. Note on the failing payload: some clients encode exp as string/float; comparisons did `==`. Fix will normalize to int and use `now >= exp_ts` not equality. Example I'll include in PR:
```
exp_ts = int(float(payload.get('exp', 0)))
if now >= exp_ts:
  reject()
```

ana: (typo) I mean ana: I'll own the perms heatmap. Plan: run the policy-diff engine across prod/staging, produce a CSV of roles with drift score and owner suggestion, then open a PR to assign owners. ETA 5 days.

ana: also propose a tiny policy: deny-any-change-without-owner for high-priv roles; can be soft-block with alert at first.

platform-sre: For audit-guard I'll add metric audit.events.gap_seconds and an alert if gap > 1800s for any service. Backfill helper will have dry-run mode. For secrets delta analyzer: reconcile versions across envs and expose `GET /secrets/reconcile?dry_run=true`. Rolling reconcile only.

eng-lead: Can we get reminders on these? Owners often forget until T-6h.

sec-bot: Reminder workflow: T-24h and T-6h created for owners. Weekly digest for tag "authz" enabled. Use `/remind` to change. :robot_face:

carmen: Good. Paste a single-line accept with epoch due timestamp and react :thumbsup: so I can lock them into the remediation tracker. I'll also schedule a monthly "pattern sweep" that looks for token+perm clusters; we've had several similar incidents.

leo: :thumbsup: I accept  Due: 2012470278 (48h).

ana: :thumbsup: I accept  Due: 2012765478 (5d).

platform-sre: :thumbsup: I accept  Due (audit): 2012609478 (72h).

platform-sre: :thumbsup: I accept  Due (secrets): 2012878278 (96h).

leo: I'll include the failing sample in the PR and link tests here before canary.

ana: I'll push the first heatmap CSV to the tracker and link it in this thread.

platform-sre: Will post dry-run counts for backfill and reconcile outputs here before activating.

eng-lead: Please include a short retro paragraph when items are closed so I can share with other team leads. Aim for 2-3 sentences summarizing root cause and guardrail changes.

carmen: Will do. One more cross-cutting ask: add an automated guardrail that fails deploys when a high-priv role changes without owner label. Ana, can you include that in your PR as a soft-block?

ana: Yes, will add as a soft-block and an alert the first two times, then escalate if repeated.

sec-bot: Follow-up doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/2012345678/aftercare  reminders and checklist attached.

platform-sre: small note: reconcile job will avoid mass restarts by POSTing new creds to the in-service endpoint where possible. We'll list priority services first.

leo: PR & tests ETA ~12h. Will ping here when canary passes.

carmen: Thanks all. Closing this thread; I'll reopen if any blocker appears.
